On the positive side, the formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it suitable for daily wear. However, I was disappointed to find that it didn't completely deliver on the "zero-cast" claim. Additionally, while the moisturizing finish is a plus, I found it lacking in hydration for my dry skin during the more intense summer days. Overall, while the Anua Zero-Cast Moisturizing Finish Sunscreen has its strengths, such as being lightweight and easy to apply, the slight white cast and the need for more hydration make it just an average product for me.
